title: ProductionOperation
description: One manufacturing step inside a routing card. Generic evaluation schema — not a wire format for the production system.

sequence.description: Order of the step within the routing (1-based).

workCenterId.description: Work centre or machine group identifier as known to planning.

setupMinutes.description: Standard setup / changeover time in minutes.

runMinutesPerUnit.description: Run time minutes per finished unit at this step.

operators.description: Typical headcount required at the step.
